name: go-panic
summary: POST /panic makes the Go service assign into a nil map inside a goroutine; the unrecovered runtime panic crashes the process and prints a real Go panic block.
expected_log_signature: panic: assignment to entry in nil map
ground_truth: The Go service's /panic handler starts a goroutine that assigns into a nil map, which triggers a runtime panic (assignment to entry in nil map). The panic is unrecovered, so it terminates the whole process and Go prints the panic message followed by the goroutine stack trace.
